data.name: Judie
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name Judah, meaning 'praised'. In the New Testament, Judas Iscariot is a disciple who betrays Jesus. The name Judie is a feminine variation and carries a gentle, Judean meaning.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of God's unwavering love and grace, even in the face of betrayal.
data.numerology_meaning: Innovators, dreamers, and leaders. They are often very creative and can become spiritual leaders.

in_hebrew.name: ג'ודי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: ג'ודי הוא שם שמקורו במקרא, ומשמעותו 'יהוה הוא ישוע' או 'הוא שמחה'. השם ג'ודי נגזר מהשם העברי 'יהודה', שפירושו 'יהוה הוא ישוע' או 'הוא מודה לאלוהים'. השם היה מאוד פופולרי בקרב יהודים וגם בקרב נוצרים, והוא נושא משמעות רבה בהיסטוריה היהודית והנוצרית.

in_greek.name: Τζούντι
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Τζούντι είναι ελληνική μορφή του ονόματος Ιούδα (Ιουδάς), που σημαίνει 'δόξα Θεού' ή 'Χαρά και δόξα Θεού'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα Ιούδα αναφέρεται σε έναν από τους αποστόλους του Ιησού και σε άλλους πρόσωπα. Το όνομα Τζούντι έχει χρησιμοποιηθεί στην Εκκλησία από τους πρώτους χρόνους και θεωρείται σύμβολο πνευματικής χαράς και αφοσίωσης.

in_latin.name: Judie
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Judie originem habet in nomine hebraeo 'Iehudah', quod significat 'Deus est gratia' vel 'confessio Dei'. In Ecclesia primitiva, nomen Iuda vel Iudas in contextu christiano usitatum erat, designans gratiam et laetitiam spiritualem. Nomen Judie per saecula in traditione christiana usitatum est, significans donum Dei et gaudium spirituale.

in_english.name: Judie
in_english.meaning: Praise to God or He will be praised
in_english.long_meaning: The name Judie originates from the Hebrew name 'Yehudah', meaning 'praised' or 'he will be praised'. It is associated with Judah, one of the twelve tribes of Israel and a significant figure in the Old Testament. In Christian tradition, Judie symbolizes spiritual joy, gratitude, and devotion to God. The name has been popularized across cultures, reflecting its timeless significance and universal appeal.

biblical_reference.note: The name Judah (or Judie) originates from the biblical figure Judah, the fourth son of Jacob and Leah.

data.cultural_impact: The name Judie is associated with the gentle, refined, and Vibrant people from the land of Judah. It’s a popular name among various Christian communities and might be the preferred alternative to Judith or Judy for some parents.
data.spiritual_significance: According to scripture, the name Judah symbolizes praise and recognition towards God, and the name Judie can serve as a reminder to give thanks and praise to God in our daily lives. It is also a reminder of the unwavering faith and devotion of the people of Judah, who even in times of hardship, remained steadfast in their beliefs.
